accept_probability: min(1, p[selected] / q_mix[selected]) = min(1, S_raw / (T * selected_multiplicity))
child_occurrence_rule: every valid child occurrence contributes independently, including duplicate tokens
distinct_token_reduction: when every drafted token is unique, each drafted-token residual is max(p[t] * (1 - 1 / S), 0) and is zero because S <= 1
fallback: when residual mass is zero, sample from the normalized target row
inverse_cdf_rule: first token whose cumulative mass is strictly greater than uniform * total_mass
normalization: T = sum_t raw_target[t], p[t] = raw_target[t] / T
q_mix: q_mix[t] = sum_i(1[child_i=t] * p[child_i] / S) = multiplicity[t] * p[t] / S
residual: r[t] = max(p[t] - q_mix[t], 0), normalized only for sampling
source_selection: source_i is sampled proportional to p[child_i]; global target normalization cancels
sparse_sampling_equivalence: block selection followed by in-block selection uses the same unnormalized residual mass because categorical sampling is scale invariant
